defects.title: The contrast of the placeholder text in the chat input box is slightly low against the dark background. -> Increase the contrast of the input placeholder text for better accessibility.

referenceComparisons.borrowedConvention: Cell-level collaboration presence should show ownership without blocking nearby work.
referenceComparisons.note: Presence claims and short agent intent chips sit on cells as advisory state; final writes still use CAS.

referenceComparisons.borrowedConvention: Multiplayer cursors and object-level activity are visible but do not freeze the canvas.
referenceComparisons.note: Agent planning and commit leases are presence rows, while proposal cards appear only for meaning conflicts.

referenceComparisons.borrowedConvention: Triage collects work that must be accepted, assigned, or dismissed.
referenceComparisons.note: Noteworthy inbox, proposal chips, trace rows, and job cards keep next actions explicit.

referenceComparisons.borrowedConvention: Empty writing surfaces should invite capture without saving placeholder text.
referenceComparisons.note: Notebook ghost text appears only in the empty first paragraph and never persists to Convex.

referenceComparisons.borrowedConvention: Records need identity, source chips, and dense relationship context.
referenceComparisons.note: Company rows use initials, source chips, status, and evidence-bearing fields.

referenceComparisons.borrowedConvention: Chat and generated work product should be adjacent, with reviewable output state.
referenceComparisons.note: Copilot, Work Surface, Trace, and proposal chips keep chat, artifact, and proof connected.

blockers: functional gate not run in this design-quality pass
